prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was bouncing between cities a lot—there was that stretch when I kept going from Beijing over to Shanghai and it all blurred together.
And earlier that year I did a quick stop in Xi'an; I remember just wandering around and trying to squeeze in the main sights.
Then in March I was down in Suzhou for a few days—mostly canals, gardens, and way too much walking.
For that Beijing-to-Shanghai run, my colleague had already set me up on train G1 on 2025-04-29.
The ticket was under Cao Yun, and it was just Second Class—nothing fancy, but it was fine.
In Xi'an, my friend Olivia Brown handled the group outing—Huaqing Palace on 2025-03-13, and she picked an afternoon time slot.

That same trip was kind of a logistics marathon—she even did ticket_count 4 for that Huaqing Palace visit, and in Suzhou we stayed at Pan Pacific Suzhou: check-in was 2025-03-23 for 4 nights, under Yang Yu.
